stem: Meena's grandmother has mixed some paddy grains with their light husks and wants to separate them by winnowing. In which situation will winnowing successfully separate the two parts of the mixture?

options.text: In a closed room where there is no moving air at all
On a windy day in an open courtyard, where the moving air carries the light husks farther away
On a still day, by simply leaving the mixture in a heap on the ground
In a closed container that is shaken gently without any air movement

teacher.key_rationale: Winnowing requires moving air (wind or blowing) to carry the lighter component (husk) farther while the heavier component (paddy grains) falls closer. Only option B provides moving air in an open setting, so it is the correct answer; A, C and D omit the essential condition of moving air.
